Kurz.schwierig: +5 feet per square, can't Step into it
Kurz.sehr: +10 feet per square, can't Step into it
Kurz.gefahr: moving through it deals damage; the terrain sets type and amount
Kurz.schmal: Balance, Off-Guard; when hit or on a failed save, Reflex save or you fall
Kurz.uneben: Balance, Off-Guard; when hit or on a failed save, Reflex save or fall Prone
Kurz.radierer: removes terrain; right-click erases with any other brush too

Anzeigen.Name: Terrain Brush: Show terrain
Anzeigen.Hint: Shows the outlines of the painted terrain. It always affects movement.

Deckkraft.Name: Advanced: Opacity of the terrain lines
Deckkraft.Hint: How visible the dashed outlines are. 100 is fully opaque, 10 barely visible.

Strichstaerke.Name: Advanced: Terrain line width
Strichstaerke.Hint: How thick the outlines are drawn. Applies to the Smooth and Simple displays.

Darstellung.Name: Terrain Brush: Display
Darstellung.Hint: Smooth shows the freely painted edge, simple shows the edge along the grid (easier on old computers), off shows no lines. Terrain is always calculated.

ZaehlendeFelder.Name: Advanced: Faintly shade counting squares (GM only)
ZaehlendeFelder.Hint: Shows which squares are at least half painted and therefore cost movement.

RasterModus.Name: Advanced: Paint on the grid instead of freehand
RasterModus.Hint: Paints whole squares as up to 0.1.2, for example for rooms with straight walls.

Leiste.Werte: Area values: DC, damage and saving throw for narrow, uneven and hazardous

Werte.Gilt: Applies to everything you paint as narrow, uneven or hazardous from now on.
Werte.Leer: Empty: level-based DC for party level {stufe}, i.e. DC {sg}.

Karte.Schmal: {name} steps onto a narrow surface: Balance (Acrobatics). Off-Guard while standing on it.
Karte.Uneben: {name} steps onto uneven ground: Balance (Acrobatics). Off-Guard while standing on it.

Fehler.Speichern: Terrain Brush: The terrain could not be saved.
